---
page_title: "Data Source: axual_group"
---
Use this data source to get an axual group in Self-Service, you can reference it by name.

## Example Usage


```hcl
data "axual_group" "frontend_developers" {
 name = "Frontend Developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group's name

### Read-Only

- `email_address` (String) Group's email address
- `iam_reference` (String) The identifier of this group in the IAM system. Null for an Axual-managed group.
- `id` (String) Group's unique identifier
- `managers` (Set of String) Group's managers. A Group Manager can edit this group. Each entry is the uid of a user or of a service account. For an IAM-managed group (see `iam_reference`) this is the stored list.
- `members` (Set of String) Group's members. Each entry is the uid of a user or of a service account. For an IAM-managed group (see `iam_reference`) this is the stored list, not the people in the IAM group.
- `phone_number` (String) Group's phone number
